name: lecture-designer
description: Design, structure, or improve a university lecture or lecture series on ML, AI, trustworthy AI, conformal prediction, uncertainty quantification, or related CS topics. Scaffolds from topic to learning objectives to structure to examples to assessment questions. Use when preparing new lectures, redesigning existing ones, or building course modules. Triggers on: "design a lecture on", "structure a lecture about", "help me teach", "what should I cover in", "build a course module", "create lecture slides outline", "learning objectives for", "how to explain X to students".
